EGT Digital showcases the strength of its growing iGaming portfolio at G2E 2026

EGT Digital is heading to G2E 2026 with a comprehensive showcase of its latest iGaming solutions. Against the backdrop of the company’s continued development across the Americas, visitors to stand 3352 will be able to explore a portfolio designed to give operators greater choice across content, betting and technology.

0:00 / 2:33

The Sportsbook will be among the key highlights of EGT Digital’s presentation. At the forefront will be Progressive Jackpot Sport, an innovative solution developed by EGT Digital that brings progressive jackpot mechanics into sports betting. The showcase will also feature Dynamic Parlays, Boosted Bet Builders, Early Payouts, Odds Booster and Player Markets, combining a broad betting offering with features focused on creating a more engaging player experience.

 

EGT Digital will also bring to Las Vegas its growing portfolio of more than 250 in-house developed casino games. The Black Bell Link series will take a prominent place with Black Lounge, Black Diamond, Black Seven and Black Clover, the latter having ranked as the #1 New Slot Game in Europe for three consecutive months in the Eilers & Krejcik Gaming performance reports.

The casino showcase will also span some of the company’s latest and most successful concepts. The High RTP Series will feature Hermes Fortunes 2000, Sugar Duke and 40 Shining Rainbow, while 7×7 Fruity Shots, Sugartime 1000 and 40 Burning Hot will represent the Buy Bonus Series. The expanding Ventura Family will bring together Panda Ventura, Tiger Ventura, Gecko Ventura, Rabbit Ventura and Ox Ventura, offering different themes and gameplay experiences within a recognisable game concept.

 

Beyond gaming content, visitors will be able to explore EGT Digital’s Bonus Hub, which enables operators to create promotional experiences through tournaments, Gift Spins, leaderboards and automated campaigns.

 

Completing the company’s G2E presentation will be X-Nave, EGT Digital’s modular iGaming platform. Its four main modules – Sportsbook, Gaming Aggregator, CRM Engine and Payment Gateway – can work together as a complete solution or be implemented independently according to an operator’s business needs.

 

The Gaming Aggregator provides access to more than 20,000 games from over 200 providers, while the modular architecture of X-Nave gives operators the flexibility to select, combine and scale the technology they need as their business develops.

 

With its presence at G2E 2026, EGT Digital will demonstrate how its growing portfolio brings together proprietary content, player engagement, Sportsbook innovation and flexible platform technology to support operators across different markets and stages of growth.

Meet EGT Digital at G2E 2026, stand 3352.
